## ✨ Added

- Confetti when an upload finishes: the moment an upload reaches 100% and the share link appears, a short gold and violet confetti burst celebrates it. It loads lazily, so it adds nothing to the first paint, and it stays off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

## 🎨 Design

- One floating-glass design throughout: the result panel after an upload and the download page wear the same frosted, raised glass surface as the drop zone, so every screen feels like one piece.
- The logo takes you back to the start: clicking it resets the upload on the home page and links home from a download page.
- Clearer copy: the headline, subtitle, drop zone, result and download wording now say plainly what featherdrop does. Files are encrypted at rest, deleted automatically when they expire, and nobody needs an account. The result page repeats that reassurance.
- The "featherdrop" wordmark, in the header and on the download page, is set in Bitter (a humanist slab serif), Medium 500 Italic. It is self-hosted through `next/font/google` (subset, preloaded, no external request, no font file in the repo). The rest of the interface keeps its clean sans-serif.

## 🌐 Translations

- The English and German copy is refreshed. The other languages keep their current translations until they're updated.
